plan.acceptance: Real full-source native primary and independent review for every completed stage. Initial assesses the opinion with report_assessment=null; accepted revision/final stages require four true ReportAssessment flags; fresh requires pass>=85 without material false or missed findings.
plan.semantic_failure_rule: A semantic rejection ends that case dependency and the next independent case may continue. Identity/source/native/checkpoint/protocol/transport/budget/availability failure stops the batch.
plan.stop_rule: No retry, reassessment, restart, old-review reuse, or qualification credit.
limitations: Candidate policy and keyed editor are unproven teaching hypotheses.
Preparation and local tests are not model or product evidence.
